customer.business: Passion4Growth: New-Market Sprint for logistics, wholesale and manufacturing companies in CEE (meetings with buyers in a new country or segment), run on the P4G outreach skill pack
customer.target: Owners, CEOs and commercial directors of logistics/3PL, wholesale/distribution and manufacturing/export companies in Bulgaria and CEE with roughly EUR 2-50M revenue, whose new business depends on referrals, trade fairs and the owner's network
customer.where: Bulgaria, Romania, Greece and the wider CEE region

pitch:
Passion4Growth (Sofia) works only with logistics, wholesale and manufacturing companies in CEE: we get you meetings with buyers in a new country or segment, beyond referrals and trade fairs.
Before you pay anything: after one 30-minute call, within 5 working days we show you 15 real target companies in your niche and market, why each one fits, and the first message we would send them in the local language. If it does not look right, you walk away. Not entering the market yet? Take the sample now and book a start date for later.
The 60-day New-Market Sprint: we set up the targeting, the offer and the outreach (email from separate warmed-up domains, LinkedIn and phone, each country's legal rules checked). You approve the target list and every first message; a person approves every reply. Your time: about 3 hours in total. Before every meeting you get a one-page brief on the company and the person.
Price: EUR 3,000. EUR 1,500 at the start; the other EUR 1,500 is due only after the 5th qualified meeting has taken place. Qualified means: a decision-maker (owner, buying, logistics or commercial lead) at a company you approved, in a call or visit about buying from you. We sign this definition together, and you can reject a meeting within 24 hours. If 5 do not happen within 90 days, you never pay the second half.
Included: a GDPR pack for each target country (checklist, legitimate-interest assessment, a contract that says who controls the data). Past client: a logistics company got 45 meetings in 2 months; we put you in touch with a past client in the closest niche.
After the Sprint, optional: EUR 1,500 a month to keep it running, cancel with 30 days' notice.
